summary: Comprehensive testing of NEW quota/rate limiting features for StrategiIA (3 analyses/month per email) and Chatbot (5 questions/session). All 11 features tested successfully. Backend APIs verified via pytest (8/8 passed). Frontend UI verified via Playwright including email registration flow, quota badges, quota exhaustion screens, and redirect links.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent badge overlay intercepts clicks - requires force=True or JS click to interact

TEST 2: StrategiIA shows quota badge in header after email submission ('3 analyses gratuites restantes')
TEST 3: StrategiIA quota badge visible with correct format 'X analyse(s) gratuite(s) restante(s)'
TEST 4: StrategiIA quota exceeded screen shows 'Quota atteint' with links to /dossier-express, /tarifs, /agenda
TEST 5: Backend GET /api/strategiia/quota/{email} returns {remaining:3, limit:3, used:0} for new email
TEST 6: Backend POST /api/strategiia/analyze returns 400 without email field ('Email obligatoire')
TEST 7: Chatbot shows quota badge in header (X/5 format, e.g., '5/5')
TEST 8: Chatbot shows 'Il vous reste X questions gratuites' text below input
TEST 9: Chatbot after 5 messages shows quota exceeded banner with links to /agenda, /dossier-express, /tarifs
TEST 10: Backend POST /api/chatbot 6th message returns redirect message with 'limite' text

Good data-testid coverage for all interactive elements enabling automated testing
